setup: Optimized native headless stock Zaton. A disposable Lua fixture spawns a stock armed stalker and delivers a controlled hit. A private socket harness supplies player poses.
timingLimitations: The first cold-start write saw one NPC update before the feed reached its steady cadence. An earlier steady run recorded four updates in one write window and failed the initial five-update harness criterion. The final run records both pre-window and during-window counts. Concurrent updates prove the disk delay did not stop the simulation. NPC cadence varied and a 100–200-player load was not tested.

earlierSynchronousMacRestart.notes: The first replacement attempted startup before macOS released the old process lock. The verified Rust import used the same save and outbox after the lock became available.

remaining: Recheck in-place x86-64 restart with the asynchronous host and measure capture and NPC cadence at target population.
